source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, cover TEMP_PCIE_SW_0~1, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both lists and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 29.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but fabricates an aggregate title sensor, truncates OOB-only output and omits both switch identities and Web.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires switch0/switch1 bus/location/topology and complete five-view evidence.

old_problem: `TEMP_PCIE_SW_0~1` denotes two intended PCIe-switch members, yet the literal tilde filter is not a reliable expansion and DeepSeek replaces them with an aggregate title sensor. Without bus, physical location and upstream/downstream fabric mapping, one healthy switch can be mistaken for the other; criteria jump from 2 to 29.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by retaining switch 0 and 1 independently and parameterizing their board location, management identity and PCIe topology under ED-03. ED-13 governs an absent second switch, ED-15 preserves authoritative limits, and ED-19 prevents collapsing coverage. Passive width/speed/AER context is collected without reset, retrain, margining or configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2025, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2026 / Wistron-BMC-01046-V002 / 60304649646b1089.
Switch indices are meaningful only after binding part/firmware, bus/location and upstream/downstream endpoints; values from one fabric branch cannot satisfy another.
The two members are selected separately from complete untruncated IB/OOB inventories and mapped to both Web records; `0~1` is not executed as a literal range selector.
Read-only negotiated width/speed and AER/error context can expose a thermal record mapped to a degraded path, while active PCIe operations remain outside this case.
Criteria 1, 2 and 29 are kept; absent 3-28 are not invented.
No ipmitool, PCIe query, authentication, Web capture, switch reset/retrain/margin/configuration, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: PCIe switch 0/1 topology-bound thermal reporting reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify thermal sensors for both specified PCIe switches, binding each index to exact bus/board location and upstream/downstream fabric path and reconciling all fields across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/BIOS identity and switch0/switch1 part, firmware, bus and physical board location
Per-switch upstream/downstream ports, endpoints and expected negotiated width/speed topology
Versioned TEMP_PCIE_SW_0/_1 five-view map, limits/states/thresholds/freshness and approved absent-switch behavior
Approved passive PCIe/AER collection, ipmitool and protected IB/OOB/Web access
Platform/PCIe/BMC owner and human Web/verdict responsibility
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; construct separate switch0 and switch1 rows bound to bus/location and complete fabric paths. Preserve logs. Capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before selecting the two stable records separately, capture both Web rows, and collect passive negotiated width/speed plus existing AER/error/thermal context. Compare each switch to its map/SPEC. Do not use `0~1` literally, aggregate indices, reset/retrain/margin/configure a switch or link, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Each applicable switch has exactly one correctly mapped, fresh and SPEC-valid thermal record with consistent fields across all five views; expected width/speed is maintained and no new PCIe or thermal error is present.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent switch0/switch1 topology identities and complete five-view evidence meeting approved limits. FAIL on swapped or ambiguous mapping, missing/extra/duplicate/stale record, mismatch, degraded width/speed, disallowed new error or thermal limit breach. Unspecified absent-switch behavior or limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no switch reset, link retrain, margining, hot-plug, firmware/configuration or threshold write.
Preserve complete sensor and PCIe evidence before filtering; protect credentials.
Stop on ambiguous topology, degraded link, new AER/error, missing/duplicate/stale telemetry or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first fabric and thermal state.
expected_evidence: Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for both switches
Per-switch comparison plus passive width/speed/AER/error/thermal context
test_case.recovery: On wrong topology, access failure, telemetry mismatch, link degradation, new error or thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reset, retrain, margin, reconfigure, clear logs or retry; escalate exact switch bus/location and fabric path.

source_conflict.reason: A two-row topology matrix resolves index semantics and replaces literal tilde/aggregate handling; an absent switch is N/A only by SPEC.

blocked.reason: Passive test semantics, evidence, safety and recovery are complete; switch/topology identities and limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Switch0/switch1 bus/location/firmware and fabric paths, per-index sensor map/limits, expected width/speed/error baseline and absent-switch rule.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO TOPOLOGY-BOUND TWO-SWITCH PASSIVE MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, PCIE QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, RESET/RETRAIN/MARGIN/CONFIGURATION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Defines AER reporting context used only as retained read-only evidence, not fault injection or recovery authorization.
